children: Overview
Canada real estate lender posted Q3 net loss as credit losses rose on non-performing loans
Q3 distributable income and net investment income were stable year-over-year
Company aims to accelerate resolution of staged loans and redeploy capital into performing assets
Outlook
Company expects remaining staged exposures to decline meaningfully over the near term
Vancouver retail/development portfolio sale expected to complete by end of Q1 2027
Distributable income payout ratio expected to remain elevated until asset sales and redeployment
Result Drivers

CREDIT LOSSES - Co said Q3 results were driven by higher expected credit losses, mainly from lower recovery values on Stage 3 mortgage investments, especially the Vancouver retail/development portfolio
STABLE CORE INCOME - Net investment income and distributable income remained stable year-over-year despite credit losses
LOAN RESOLUTION STRATEGY - Co said it is accelerating resolution of staged loans and plans to redeploy recovered capital into performing mortgage investments
